name: Mizel.ai
short_desc: Record meetings with live words, Ask cards and a live summary, and search transcripts.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Empty-by-default recorder backend with notes, native capture, audio upload, HTTP API, MCP and shared transcription.

form_fields.label: Shared transcription slot API (optional)
form_fields.hint: Container-network endpoint of the selected transcription provider. The default points at the Transcriber app. No model is bundled.

form_fields.label: Additional trusted browser origins (optional)
form_fields.hint: Same-host origins work automatically. Add comma-separated exact origins only if needed.

form_fields.label: Trusted ingress hosts (optional)
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated host:port values. Blank uses the owner-authenticated Wizard ingress.

form_fields.label: Owner name in notes (optional)
form_fields.hint: Notes, titles and action items name this person instead of 'Me'. Blank keeps 'Me'.

form_fields.label: Live words key (optional)
form_fields.hint: Tinfoil API key for live words and the live summary on the Live screen (turn it on in Try changes). Blank leaves the live screen unconfigured.

form_fields.label: Your main agent's name (optional)
form_fields.hint: The name the live screen uses for Ask cards and answers, e.g. the name you call your agent. Blank shows 'Wizard'.

form_fields.label: Agent endpoint for Ask (optional)
form_fields.hint: Container-network address of your Wizard agent API (the /wizard/hermes prefix). Blank: Ask cards say the agent is not connected.
